label_style: name the cost before the reward

code_form.text: Corrin Vane's own code: small knots tied into loops of cord, or chalked as knot-shapes, each pattern standing for a letter, used on ledgers, panels, and levers throughout the playhouse.

access_route.text: A loose brick three courses up on the alley wall hides a shallow niche where a small brass stage key is tucked behind a curl of ivy.

shelved_item.text: A handful of blank notebook pages packed for taking notes; once the marginalia's line is decoded there is nothing left to jot down, so the pages stay on the shelf by the door.

access_route.text: A warped wooden side door beside the main stage door, swollen shut in its frame but not locked, openable with a good steady push.

shelved_item.text: A small crowbar packed in case the door needed prying; once bare hands prove enough to shove it open, the crowbar stays behind on the shelf.

access_route.text: Nan Ferris, the playhouse's caretaker, personally walking the friends in through her own side entrance after judging them fit to try the dare.

shelved_item.text: A second oil lantern Nan offers from the hook by her door; the friends already have one lantern between them, so the spare stays hanging on her wall.

hint_carrier.text: A hand-drawn diagram of the loft's rigging pinned to the stairwell wall, its ropes and pulleys labeled in small knot-code marks.

wonder.text: A small hand-carved wooden mask, one of Vane's own, left forgotten in the rafters above the topmost stair.

hint_carrier.text: A thick rehearsal ledger open on the archive's reading table, its margins dense with knot-code notes explaining the control bridge's levers in detail.

wonder.text: A small music box on a side shelf, still wound tight, ready to play a soft tune the moment its lid is lifted.

hint_carrier.text: Years of hands sliding along the catwalk rail have worn its old paint into a pattern of knot-code shapes, legible from the safe end of the walk.

obstacle.text: A narrow wooden catwalk strung high above the stage, just wide enough for careful footsteps, with a low rail on one side only.

hint_carrier.text: A repeating pattern cut into the understage's floor joists, small pegs and notches that spell out knot-code when read by touch in the dim light.

wonder.text: A large pale moth that lives permanently in the understage, its wings dusted with silvery powder, clinging still and calm to a support post.

remedy.text: A short coil of spare cord, spliced carefully into the lever's broken linkage the way the rigging diagram showed, to steady it without pretending it isn't broken.

contents.text: Corrin Vane's own letter, sealed with wax and a small knot, resting on the workshop desk.
A small carved wooden token, worn smooth as a favorite coin, sitting in a shallow dish.
A faded program listing decades of Bellhollow Playhouse shows, some names on it still familiar around town.

loft_signature.text: A workbench scattered with fresh wood shavings that are still faintly warm, as though Corrin Vane had only just stepped away from it.

safeguard.text: A small chime rigged to the stage's counterweights that rings softly whenever they are loaded past their proper balance, the puppet-maker's own gentle alarm for overreaching hands.
